deviations: The original PurePosixPath implementation already normalizes ./, repeated / and trailing /. These are deliberately planted exercise defects, not asserted original-source bugs. Correct safe_waves dependency validation is provided, avoiding a repeat of lesson 44 invalid-plan scheduling.

A read_only flag and nonblank accountable-owner rule make the lesson explicit roles executable. The plan preview checks disjoint write contracts; Part 5 separately audits an organization policy allowing overlapping claims only under transitive serial dependency.

The source does not teach Lamport clocks or watermarks. Part 4 uses a fully documented private NDJSON handoff verdict stream and dependency barrier, matching the integrator requirements without invented protocol facts.
Part 5 exposes every prefix claimant and reports concurrent overlaps; it does not use longest-prefix selection to hide multiple concurrent owners.

Evidence id encoding helpers and line serialization are provided correct; byte preservation and O_EXCL are the persistence focus. Integration is deterministic review of supplied proof/diff/gate records, not a real Git or shell execution.

The provided name codec uses uppercase Base32 with restored 8-character padding groups, keeping distinct opaque ids separate on case-insensitive filesystems. Case-fold uniqueness and h/NUL independent byte roundtrips are helper guards, not an additional candidate defect. Encoded sort order still differs from decoded lexical order.
